stem: 6. If S = {square, rectangle, circle, rhombus, triangle}, list the elements of the following subset of S.
tamilStatus: pending original Tamil source transcription and independent editorial review

entries.question: The set of shapes which have 4 equal sides.
steps: Restrict attention to the five named shapes in S.
A square has four equal sides, and a rhombus has four equal sides.
A general rectangle does not require all sides equal; collect the qualifying shapes.

entries.question: The set of shapes which have radius.
steps: Look only at the shapes named in S.
A circle is described by its radius.
The remaining named polygons are not defined by a radius in this context.

entries.question: The set of shapes in which the sum of all interior angles is 180o.
steps: A triangle's interior angles sum to 180°.
The listed quadrilaterals have interior-angle sum 360°.
A circle is not a polygon with interior angles.
entries.mathCheck: Polygon angle sum (n−2)×180° for n=3 gives 180°.

entries.question: The set of shapes which have 5 sides.
steps: List the shapes in S: square, rectangle, circle, rhombus, triangle.
The listed polygons have either three or four sides; a circle has no straight sides.
No member of S has five sides.
